stickyNotes.text: Nightly scheduled job scans t_crm_payment_plans: when due_date < CURRENT_DATE and status = Pending, set status = "Overdue", is_overdue = 1, and notify the AE and Finance.
credit_code must match the 18-character uppercase alphanumeric pattern (^[0-9A-Z]{18}$), remain globally UNIQUE, and block physical deletion while open contracts exist.
Generate contract_no sequentially as HT-YYYY-NNNN with idempotent uniqueness checks; contract_amount must have 2 decimal places (> 0) and reference an existing account.
State guard: only contracts in "Pending Legal" may transition to "Active" or "Rejected"; rejected drafts must be revised before re-entering review.
Enforce composite uniqueness uq_contract_stage(contract_id, stage_no) and verify that SUM(plan_amount) across stages equals parent contract_amount.

Anti-overcollection rule: lock parent contract row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, assert received_amount + plan_amount <= contract_amount, atomically increment received_amount, and mark contract "Completed" when paid in full.

Anti-overbilling & tax check: 1) Contract status must be Active or Completed; 2) invoiced_amount + apply_amount <= contract_amount; 3) Special VAT requires an 18-char tax_no; atomically increment invoiced_amount on issue.
Mobile and desktop approvals share optimistic locking: if Legal already processed a contract on desktop, mobile taps show "Status already updated" and refresh.
Backend computes remaining invoiceable quota = contract_amount - invoiced_amount - pending requests, rejecting requests that exceed remaining balance.

notes.title: Monetary Precision (DECIMAL 14,2) & Tax Rounding Rules
notes.html:
1. Storage & Serialization Precision

  • All monetary columns use DECIMAL(14,2) (binary floating-point FLOAT / DOUBLE arithmetic is prohibited).
  • Tax rate columns use DECIMAL(5,2) (standard tiers: SaaS services 6.00%, hardware/software goods 13.00%).

2. Tax Separation & Penny-Rounding Rule

apply_amount represents the tax-inclusive total:

  • net_amount = ROUND(apply_amount / (1 + tax_rate / 100), 2);
  • tax_amount = apply_amount - net_amount (computed by subtraction so net + tax always equals gross total to the cent).

notes.title: Contract, Milestone & VAT Invoicing State Machines & Invariants
notes.html:
1. Core Document State Machines

  • Sales Contracts (t_crm_contracts.status): Draft → Pending Legal → (approved) → Active → (100% collected) → Completed; rejected reviews return to Rejected for revision.
  • Payment Milestones (t_crm_payment_plans.status): Pending → (past due) → Overdue → (bank wire matched) → Reconciled.
  • Tax Invoice Requests (t_crm_invoices.status): Pending Finance → (approved & issued) → Issued; invalid tax ID or quota returns to Rejected.

2. Cross-Table Transactional Invariants

  1. Milestone Conservation: Sum of plan_amount per contract_id equals contract_amount, with composite uniqueness on (contract_id, stage_no).
  2. Collection Cap: At all times received_amount <= contract_amount; reconciling the final installment transitions the contract to Completed in the same transaction.
  3. Invoicing Cap: Only Active and Completed contracts can be billed, with invoiced_amount + pending + apply_amount <= contract_amount.
